verdict.rationale: Milvus docs explicitly describe full-text search that auto-converts text to sparse (BM25-style) embeddings, multi-vector search that runs multiple ANN searches simultaneously, and Milvus Lite covering 'sparse and dense vector search... multi-vector and hybrid_search,' confirming a combined dense+sparse hybrid query capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of fusion ranking strategies (e.g., RRF/weighted ranker names) and independent/hands-on corroboration of hybrid_search quality in practice.
